answer: Before the fletching the arrowbinder works at the arrowloft, shapes the bow at dawn and waxes the string till the midnight bell. The bowyard is vouched by Birch brace shaftmaker bowfield attestation: a attestation brace shaftmakers aim twice bowfield bow tallies hold. While lotus carves the bow, shale looses the arrow and mesa notches the arrow. A loose bow never holds aim: 67211 slackened bows and 67211 slackened arrows must answer for it.
